entries.alt: The brother of Jared kneels on a mountain and arranges sixteen pale translucent stones in two groups on a flat rock.
entries.caption: The brother of Jared prepares sixteen stones on the mountain before asking the Lord to give them light. His careful preparation leads into an earnest prayer.
entries.findings: Full original inspected: left group has eight stones including fingertip-held stone, right group has eight. All separately countable, pale translucent and unlit; no divine hand or Christ visible. Corrected one added stone per group from rejected14stone original. Face, hair, forehead band, hands and woven clothing preserve directly inspected approved reference continuity.
conditions: Sixteen-stone source count verified; do not describe stones as already shining.
Preserve rejected original and review80 unchanged.

entries.recommendedTitle: Good news on the road home
entries.alt: An official listens to a servant speaking on a rural road while an older gray-bearded servant approaches behind him.
entries.caption: Servants meet the official on his way home with news that his son is alive. He listens and asks when the recovery began.
entries.findings: Full original inspected and compared: rear servant now visibly older with gray beard, receding hair, deeper facial lines and different nose/brow proportions. Distinct from central dark-haired speaker; cloning concern resolved. Official and speaker, reciprocal eye contact, hands, clothing, road and composition preserved. Photographic skin and cloth remain coherent.
conditions: Official in John4, not centurion of Luke7; recovered child is his son, not servant.
Appearance, exact ages and location are interpreted.
Preserve rejected original and review81 unchanged.
